page_title: horita: Next meeting countdown for the Mac menu bar

summary.name: horita
summary.one_liner: horita is a free, open-source Mac menu bar app that shows a countdown to your next meeting and joins Zoom, Google Meet or Microsoft Teams calls in one click.
keywords: join google meet from menu bar
use_cases: See how long until your next meeting without opening a calendar
Join a Zoom, Google Meet or Teams call from the menu bar in one click
Get full-screen or banner reminders before meetings
Hide meeting titles while screen sharing
Review the rest of your day's meetings in a dropdown
summary.what_it_does: horita sits in the Mac menu bar and shows a small icon that turns into a countdown when a meeting is close; the lead time is user-configurable. Clicking the icon opens a dropdown listing the rest of the day's meetings, with details such as location, organizer and attendees on hover. A summary line shows how many meetings remain, how busy the day is, and marks overlaps and back-to-back meetings. It reads calendars already added to macOS (iCloud, Google, Exchange, Outlook.com) and detects Zoom, Google Meet and Teams links, including ones buried in event notes. Optional banner or full-screen reminders and a screen-share-safe mode that hides meeting titles are also available.
notable: Reads macOS Calendar data locally; no account, analytics or telemetry, only update checks
Global keyboard shortcut and right-click to join the next meeting
Signed, notarized, and installable via Homebrew cask
caveats: Only Zoom, Google Meet and Microsoft Teams links are detected; other services such as Webex are not yet
Direct Google Calendar connection for accounts not added to macOS is still in development
